candidates.rationale: Fetches successfully, 2 routes and 281 trips, but describes no service after 2022-12-31. Checked on 2026-08-02 whether the file was merely stale or actually abandoned: it was last modified 2023-09-26, its members are dated 2023-09-11, and its feed_version is 20230830, so the calendar was already a year expired when the file was last built. Twelve sibling feeds on the same host and path pattern are current, one of them modified 2025-10-24, so the publisher is refreshing the others and not this one. The agency still reports to NTD, so the URL is worth re-checking after the next annual release rather than treated as permanently dead.
